# Introduction

It is important to note that recent studies have shown the crucial role of digital note-taking in the ever-evolving field of higher education. Furthermore, the literature suggests that mobile devices matter here. Moreover, this paradigm shift underscores the importance of student behaviour. Additionally, a growing body of research delves into these questions.

In order to address this gap, our study may possibly suggest that students might generally prefer mobile devices.

This research is highly original. This research is deeply grounded. This research is well designed. This research is clearly framed. This research is widely relevant. This research is broadly applicable.

The main contributions are as follows:

- Provide a review of the field.
- Provide an analysis of survey data.
- Provide a set of recommendations.
- Provide an agenda for future work.
